description: Summary. Send text (up to 60,000 characters) or a public page or PDF URL; returns a summary as paragraphs, bullets or one line, short, medium or long, with an optional focus, plus the source and a truncated flag (input past 60,000 characters is cut). Use to brief an agent or a person. Not for sourced answers (use /v1/research-answer) or set fields (use /v1/extract). Typical response 3 to 10 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.03 (USDC, x402).

focus.description: Optional: what the summary should concentrate on.

style.description: Paragraphs, a bulleted list or one sentence.

url.description: Or a public page or PDF to summarize. Send text or url.
